KnightLoader talks to every debrid service itself, MyDebrid included, and the relay is now ParleyPort. Every change is listed in [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/knightloader/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).

## ✨ Added

- **MyDebrid.** KnightLoader talks to MyDebrid directly, with the username and password of your MyDebrid account. The Accounts page shows the plan and when it runs out. MyDebrid does not take torrents.
- **ParleyPort on the Apps page.** The "On a server" card offers [ParleyPort](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/parleyport), the relay you can run yourself, next to Unraid, Docker and the source code. A click copies the command that starts it.

## ⚡ Improved

- **Every debrid service is KnightLoader's own.** Multihosters reached through JDownloader are gone from the debrid card and from the hoster login picker. LeechAll has no public API and asks for a captcha at sign-in, so KnightLoader does not support it.
- **The relay is ParleyPort.** Instances, the phone app and the browser extension reach the project relay at `parleyport.halleluja.design`. The old address keeps answering for a while, so installations that have not updated stay connected. The Own relay card and the docs name ParleyPort.
- **Captcha solvers are called captcha accounts,** in every language and in the phone app.

## 🐛 Fixed

- **Captcha accounts show their services' logos,** in the dark theme too.
- **The Accounts page loads at once.** A hoster icon that had not been fetched yet could hold up the page for half a minute or more. Icons now load in the background, and a hoster without one shows its first letter.
